// name: Unscoped on purpose: vsce rejects a scoped npm name as an extension identifier.
name: agent-watcher-bridge
description: Sends workspace, active editor, focus and diagnostics to the Agent Watcher overlay. It cannot observe Claude Code's state — that comes from hooks.

agentWatcher.port.description: Port the Agent Watcher desktop app listens on. Must match the app's config.

agentWatcher.token.markdownDescription: Optional override. By default the token is read from the desktop app's local config file, so it is never stored in VS Code settings (and never travels through Settings Sync).
